_README: Skills-only by default: this plugin contributes the skills and uses whichever paperless-bulk MCP server you ALREADY have registered (e.g. a user-scope `paperless-bulk` entry in ~/.claude.json / ~/.mcp.json). There is intentionally no active `mcpServers` block here, so installing the plugin never double-registers or fails on missing env vars. To bundle the server WITH the plugin instead, copy the template below up into a top-level "mcpServers" key and provide the env vars. See README.
